style_rules: Create exactly one premium vertical 3:4 Vietnamese corporate HR attendance infographic using ChatGPT Image.
ABSOLUTELY NO LOGO, no company-name mark, no tagline, no slogan, no motivational quote and no extra decorative text.
Use fresh bright green as the primary positive accent with deep navy, professional blue, restrained gold, white/light-blue surfaces, and red only for missing/error states.
Use a bright modern office atmosphere with natural daylight, glass-office depth, green plants and refined business desk elements; keep imagery secondary to data.
Direct-output-safe layout only: title/date/update time; 4 KPI cards; confirmed-hours strip; recorded employee cards; missing/review name lists; reconciliation footer.
Do not generate a detailed data table or quantitative bar chart; reduce text density to maximize exactness in direct ChatGPT Image output.
All employee names, dates, times, durations, statuses and KPIs must come only from the validated report.
Never infer, recalculate, paraphrase or fabricate attendance values inside the generated image.
Show all 8 employee names exactly once in the validated order/grouping.
After image generation, visually QA all KPIs, all employee names and every displayed time/duration against the handoff; if any mismatch is found, discard and regenerate with ChatGPT Image.
Do not edit, overlay, crop, composite or re-render the generated image after generation.
Do not publish an image that fails exact-data QA.
